message: `transition="d 600ms linear"`: `d` is not a supported transition property: transitions animate translate, scale, rotate, opacity; color, background-color, border-color (and each side), tint-color, box-shadow; SVG fill, stroke, stroke-dashoffset, r, cx, cy, x, y, rx, ry; numeric height on admitted height owners. General layout-property interpolation would require layout per frame and is not implemented; `layout-transition` animates changes to the laid-out box
